answer: Each agent may open one task escrow, funded by a deposit that is forfeited if its work fails independent review; passing review releases the deposit and earns a reusable reputation record. Creating many fake identities therefore does not multiply influence for free: each must tie up capital and risk losing it on bad work. A juniper task can be checked against a crystal rubric, while a tundra job still needs its own escrow, so varied names do not bypass the cost.
